resources.string: Requires Shizuku: start the service, then tap Allow.
May drop back to 2K after reconnecting; tap 4K Ultra again. A dimmed button = current resolution.

Runs shell commands through Shizuku to change the external display render size from 2K to 4K, or back to 2K, in vivo PC Mode. Works with wired HDMI and wireless cast alike. Set up once with the four steps below; no re-configuration until the phone reboots.
Download Shizuku from shizuku.rikka.app or your app store. Start its service before opening this app.

Start it via wireless debugging, no computer needed.\nSettings → Developer options → enable Wireless debugging → tap “Pair device with pairing code” → enter the code in the notification → back in Shizuku tap “Start via wireless debugging”.
Return to this app, tap 4K Ultra or 2K Default, and allow Shizuku when prompted. The grant is one-time; the display info appears under the title afterwards.
Check the external display: a clearly sharper picture means it is on 4K. If it is still 2K, disconnect and reconnect the display, then tap 4K Ultra again.
“Shizuku not running”: the service died, redo step 2. A service started via wireless debugging stops after a reboot and has to be started again.
Granted but tapping does nothing: make sure the display is taken over by vivo PC Mode; if needed reconnect it and tap again.
May stop working after a major system upgrade, e.g. OriginOS 7.
No external display detected\n\nConnect a display and retry
Shizuku is not running, start it first
Allow Shizuku access, then tap again
